# Does NIS2 apply to your company, and as an essential or an important entity?

> Free NIS2 scope checker: pick your sector and enter staff, turnover and balance sheet to see whether Directive (EU) 2022/2555 likely applies to you, as an essential or important entity, with the main duties. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
